featuresTitle: What the app shows a motorhome
feature1Text: Filter for dump stations and you also get the campsites, caravan sites, fuel stations and car parks that have one. Where it is recorded, each says whether it takes grey water and the chemical toilet, whether there is fresh water, and whether it is for customers only.
feature2Text: Search for LPG, GPL or autogas and the map brings up fuel stations. The ones recorded as selling LPG say so on their page.
feature3Text: Caravan sites and aires have a filter of their own. A campsite's page says whether it takes motorhomes and caravans, where that is recorded.
feature4Text: Drinking water, showers, launderettes, supermarkets, pharmacies and free Wi-Fi are on the same map, for when you stay in one place for a while.
ctaBlockText: Free on iOS and Android, with no subscription and no account required.
